capabilities.summary: Search explicit workspace roots and local Maildir/mbox exports with scan limits, source hashes and stale-page rejection. Prepare inert SSH argv or inspect one explicit server banner without authenticating or executing remote commands.

options.name: root|path

capabilities.summary: Local ML/statistical evidence ranking, context scoring and extractive handoffs; optional Kompress SLM paragraph selection. Automatic helpers run only when configured and eligible; discovery neither loads models nor starts inference.

options.name: context_score

options.name: handoff_capsule
options.summary: Prepare a short extractive handoff instead of copying an entire session.

options.name: automatic preprocessing
options.summary: Optional local SLM selects original paragraphs; unavailable workers preserve source text. No direct inference tool is implied.

capabilities.summary: Plan research angles and capture lead/company/contact candidates plus provenance-aware source notes with source URLs, retrieved-at timestamps and hashes. Local-only; compose with web_search/fetch_content/web_research and verify primary sources.

options.name: action
options.summary: Toolkit operation.

options.name: goal|context
options.summary: Research goal and optional context for plan.

options.name: name|company|role|domain
options.summary: Candidate identity fields for lead/company.

options.name: sourceUrl|retrievedAt
options.summary: Required http(s) provenance and timestamp.

options.name: evidence|quote
options.summary: Bounded verbatim evidence for lead/company/source.

capabilities.summary: Send and read email through AgentMail (outreach and inbox triage) with an environment-provided API key: inbox discovery, bounded sends with a required subject, compact inbox listing, full-text search, and single-message reads.

options.name: AGENTMAIL_API_KEY
options.summary: Required environment variable; read at call time and never persisted, logged or echoed.

options.name: AGENTMAIL_INBOX_ID
options.summary: Default sender inbox (usually the sending address) used when a call omits inboxId.

options.name: AGENTMAIL_BASE_URL
options.summary: Optional endpoint override, for example another AgentMail region.

options.name: to|cc|bcc|replyTo|subject|text|html|labels
options.summary: Send fields; a subject and a text or html body are required, and CR/LF is rejected.

options.name: inboxId|limit|pageToken|from|to|subject|labels|ascending|includeSpam|includeTrash
options.summary: Inbox listing scope and filters; list rows stay compact and carry a preview, and nextPageToken pages through every page.

options.name: q|before|after
options.summary: Full-text search query with optional ISO timestamp bounds; rows carry per-field match highlights.

options.name: includeHtml
options.summary: Opt-in HTML body on a single-message read.

capabilities.summary: Deterministic/Needle3/Smol/Kompress/Jev helper stack for discovery re-ranking, evidence triage, intent pre-screening and request advisories; Jev is a bounded remote OpenRouter advisory and deterministic owners keep authority when helpers are unavailable.

options.name: PI_MICRO_INTELLIGENCE
options.summary: Set to off to disable the lifecycle extension; routing, eligibility, safety and truth stay with existing owners.

options.name: PI_NEEDLE
options.summary: Set to off to disable Needle re-ranking, or PI_NEEDLE_SHADOW=1 to measure without applying.

options.name: PI_MICRO_ADVISORY
options.summary: Set to off to skip the per-request Jev advisory batch.

options.name: PI_JEV
options.summary: Set to off to disable remote Jev calls. When enabled, bounded task/request excerpts (maximum 32768 characters) may be sent to OpenRouter.
